processes.name: Fan-page poster
processes.what: Hands finished clips to the scheduler for Instagram and TikTok at the warm-up pace (2 a day per channel) and records each post’s live link.
processes.note: Scheduled posts publish on time. Live-link check resumes Fri Nov 27, 9:22 AM ET.

processes.name: Posting watchdog
processes.what: Checks the poster every 15 minutes and flags anything stuck.

processes.name: Content engine
processes.what: Scans new streams and videos, scores the moments and cuts vertical clips.

processes.name: Brand email sender
processes.what: Sends partner emails on weekdays, 3 a day at most, with one follow-up after 7 days.

processes.name: Public snapshot refresh
processes.what: Refreshes this dashboard from the live system.

processes.name: Partner-form routine
processes.what: Fills brand contact forms, hourly 10:15 AM–7:15 PM ET on weekdays. Up to 10 a day, 30+ minutes apart.

processes.name: Outreach check-in
processes.what: Confirms the day’s brand emails went out, weekdays at 3:30 PM ET.

processes.name: Warm-up ramp review
processes.what: Reviews posting pace each Monday and raises it only when the accounts are ready.
